name: Nishitani Keiji
shortBio: Major Kyoto School philosopher and student of Nishida Kitaro and Martin Heidegger who confronted modern European nihilism through Zen Buddhist emptiness (sunyata) as the existential ground of self-overcoming.
centralQuestion: Can Zen emptiness (sunyata) overcome Western nihilism by passing through the "Great Doubt" rather than retreating into dogmatism or despair?

keyWorks.title: Religion and Nothingness (Shukyo to wa nani ka)
keyWorks.description: Masterwork staging a cross-cultural encounter between Nietzsche, Heidegger, Nishida, and Mahayana sunyata to overcome nihilism.

keyWorks.title: The Self-Overcoming of Nihilism
keyWorks.description: Critical study of Stirner, Nietzsche, and Dostoevsky arguing that nihilism points beyond itself toward non-substantial emptiness.
